purpose: Select one economically distinct historical-only mechanism after Campaign055 using frozen definitions and source metadata only, before any Campaign056 source partition, candidate value, comparison value, daily price, or forward return is read.

definition_only_inventory.composition: The 78 definitions reconstructed by the frozen Campaign055 protocol in exact order, followed by terminal Campaign055.

candidate_design_catalog.reason: It compares the completed 240-bin CNY trading-activity clock with the same stock's immediately preceding accepted market session. None of the 79 frozen definitions measures cross-session persistence of a full intraday activity schedule.
Campaign049 already compares the two half-session amount distributions within one date; Campaign056 instead compares the same 240 clock bins across two consecutive accepted market sessions.
Amount concentration, clock center, adjacent within-session persistence, late share, opening share, and market synchronization are terminal same-session mechanisms.

A total-activity change would measure daily liquidity scale and overlap the existing daily volume and turnover family; the selected statistic normalizes both sessions independently and is invariant to either day's total amount.
Changing the field would reopen terminal return, range, price-update, and transaction-price families and create a source-field search. Campaign056 reads only CNY amount.

Exactly one preceding accepted market session, the full 240-bin continuous-auction clock, equal-mixture Jensen-Shannon similarity, higher direction, and no threshold, filter, subset, fit, model, or combination are frozen once.

selected_candidate.name: intraday_day_over_day_amount_profile_similarity_240b
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: A stock whose normalized minute-by-minute CNY activity schedule repeats on consecutive accepted market sessions may be undergoing a persistent multi-session execution program rather than an isolated liquidity burst; that sustained participation may remain relevant from the next open through the third close.
selected_candidate.formula: For signal session t and the immediately preceding accepted market session t-1, use the exact 240 continuous-auction amounts A_t,i and A_t-1,i at matching clock bins. Normalize each nonnegative vector to p_i=A_t,i/sum(A_t) and q_i=A_t-1,i/sum(A_t-1). Let m_i=(p_i+q_i)/2 and JSD=0.5*sum_{p_i>0}p_i*ln(p_i/m_i)+0.5*sum_{q_i>0}q_i*ln(q_i/m_i). Return 1-JSD/ln(2).
selected_candidate.session_pair_rule: signal session and exactly the immediately preceding accepted local market-calendar session
selected_candidate.amount_semantics: finite nonnegative CNY amount at every fixed clock bin; exact zeros remain in the distributions
selected_candidate.normalization: normalize each session independently by its strictly positive 240-bin total amount
selected_candidate.distance: equal-mixture Jensen-Shannon divergence with natural logarithms
selected_candidate.similarity: one minus divergence divided by ln(2)
selected_candidate.missing_rule: Require both exact 240-bin grids, an exact calendar-adjacent session pair inside the bound raw interval, all amounts finite and nonnegative, and strictly positive total amount in both sessions. Missing, duplicated, off-grid, suspended, or invalid prior-session observations are never bridged, filled, or repaired.

decision.next_action: Complete a separate pre-value overlap audit against all 79 inherited definitions, then freeze one exact coverage-first 79-comparison no-return protocol before implementation or any Campaign056 source value read.
